changes: Redesign Dashboard and subscription states, including welcome and active trial, traffic and device metrics, connection cards, and pending placeholders.
Keep VPN setup and its overlay layout stable through loading, step navigation, and dismissal. Preserve Dashboard scroll and offer a backup link only when configured.
Improve classic purchase and renewal period selection, mobile navigation, button contrast, and compact device limit controls.
Align the Profile, Balance, Support, and other Cabinet screens with the shared layout.
Open Admin at the top from Profile. Add mobile bottom navigation on the Admin home and enlarge its content with white group icons.

limitations.summary: Classic purchase still requires manual confirmation after balance top-up.
Physical Telegram Mini App and native client coverage is unverified for this release.
External panel app configuration and merchant sandbox checkout/recurring flows were not part of the verified browser scope.
The unused createEmail wrapper is unchanged; current UI uses the supported combined endpoint.
A delayed subscriptions list can temporarily expose a renewal action for an active daily tariff. Reproduced on the previous stable and this candidate.
